summary: Diagnosis of the failed held-out estimator selection (seed-specific under-resolution of weakly heterogeneous mechanisms; a gate that rejects an ideal learner at realistic sizes; impossible by construction in the agent), learned credit inside one long open objective (segments), a blocked held-out split by segment, an estimand-matched pooled selection rule over held-out randomised units of any experiment size, a revision queue for the policy update (agent hook CR-3), a controlled policy-learning diagnostic and an integrated-agent ablation (simple vs forced RUDDER / COCOA). docs/CR.md.

AM4-credit-inside-one-objective.state: implemented (credit side); agent split hook CR-1 pending

evidence.a_correctness: test_cr.py (segment credit, conservation < 1e-6, closure re-credit with history)
evidence.b_runtime: integrated agent, one open objective, 64 decisions: RUDDER credit on 56-64 of 64 records and COCOA on 46-57 before the objective closes (21 debug runs)
evidence.c_causal: only through the training default; see AM4-revised-credit-reaches-weights
evidence.d_improvement: none measured in the integrated agent (section 3 of docs/CR.md)

AM4-credit-inside-one-objective.limitations: segment returns truncate outcomes measured by later segments' queries until the objective closes; K fixed at 16 (not learned)

evidence.a_correctness: per-experiment gate fails the information-state optimum with hidden mechanisms while the pooled rule accepts it and refuses a biased estimator; orientation invariance; calibration kept where >= 5 units per arm
evidence.b_runtime: every learning update of the agent pools held-out units (0-2 per 64-decision run) and logs why nothing is promoted
evidence.c_causal: the rule sets CreditAssigner.default; it never changed the default in 64-decision runs
evidence.d_improvement: not applicable / not measured: validation at 0.5 sd needs ~100 units; ~1.5 units per 100 decisions at the agent's experimentation rate

AM4-estimand-matched-selection.limitations: the pooled bias test is a necessary condition; per-context calibration needs replicated contrasts (>= 5 units per arm)

AM4-revised-credit-reaches-weights.state: credit side implemented (CreditAssigner.pop_revised); agent hook CR-3 pending

evidence.b_runtime_c_causal: RUDDER forced: credited policy-update rows 112 / 132 / 134 with the CR-3 line vs 28 / 35 / 35 without (seeds 0-2, 64 decisions); 3 of 96 rows in the 22-decision smoke run without it; real configuration: 80 of 179 rows credited, 41 replayed

AM4-revised-credit-reaches-weights.limitations: a revision is replayed once; frequent small revisions of a still-training decomposer queue the same records repeatedly (bounded by half a policy batch)

findings: seed-specific: seed 0 fails (RUDDER 6.72, COCOA 10.89), seed 1 passes (1.42, 2.73)
RUDDER under-trained at D's 400 updates: 1600 updates on the same data give slope 1.25 vs truth and mean z^2 3.53 (ideal learner on the same data 3.10)
COCOA unstable: 1600 updates give mean z^2 32.0 and a pooled bias of -6.15 (estimates change sign)
the gate rejects an ideal learner at realistic sizes: 79 % pass at equal training / experiment size; 60 % for an exactly calibrated estimator at 2 units per arm
the first-decision latent is identical within a mechanism and distinct across mechanisms (D's 'identical across mechanisms' refuted)

AM4-credit-improves-learning.state: measured: negative in the integrated agent, positive for return-based credit in the controlled diagnostic

RC-08.limitations: with CR-1 the agent obtains held-out units inside one objective; too few in the runs measured to validate any estimator; default stays simple by evidence

CreditAssigner(..., segment_decisions=16): units, unit_of(rec), experiment_units(experiment_id, treatment=, control=) -> (List[UnitContrast], counts), pop_revised(n, estimator=None) -> List[exp_id]
cam_live.credit.select.UnitContrast, pooled_unit_score(units, name, min_units=8, margin_sd=0.5, alpha=0.05) -> PooledScore, chi2_ppf / chi2_cdf
EstimatorSelector(..., min_units=8, margin_sd=0.5, alpha=0.05, calib_min_per_arm=5, calib_alpha=0.01): add_units(units), pooled_scores(); select() uses the pooled rule when unit evidence exists
change_requests: docs/change_requests/CR.md: CR-1 (agent learner split 'segment'), CR-2 (optional, segment length from configuration), CR-3 (replay of revised credit in the policy update)

measured.patched_copy_integration: test_int3a_audit 4/4, test_int2_wiring + test_agent_runtime + test_int2_checkpoints 20/20 on a copy with CR-1 + CR-3
measured.cr3: RUDDER forced: credited policy-update rows 112 / 132 / 134 with the CR-3 line vs 28 / 35 / 35 without (seeds 0-2, 64 decisions); 3 of 96 rows in the 22-decision smoke run without it; real configuration: 80 of 179 rows credited, 41 replayed
measured.real_configuration: one hold, Qwen3-4B + 50m, backbone candidates on, RUDDER forced, one open objective: 39 decisions in 720 s, RUDDER credit on 28/39 records before closure, COCOA none (open-ended candidates refused), 80/179 policy-update rows credited (41 replayed by CR-3), no randomised experiment, no paired control (docs/evidence/CR/real_rudder_s0.json)

not_done: agent.py hooks CR-1 / CR-3 are change requests (ST)
no estimator was validated inside one objective: too few held-out units at the agent's experimentation rate
the 1600-update lab run (RUDDER under-trained at 400 updates, COCOA unstable with longer training) is a single seed
the contribution signal (validated quantity) as a per-decision learning signal would need an agent change (_credit_for treats every learned estimator as return-like); not proposed
scientific_failures: integrated agent: forcing RUDDER or COCOA credit did not improve competence over the evidence-selected simple attribution (paired differences in docs/CR.md section 3)
RUDDER's learning signal was not better than plain REINFORCE in the controlled diagnostic (regret per lifetime within one standard error)
learned credit tracks the true value of the agent's own lab.act decisions worse than simple attribution after 64 decisions (Pearson 0.22-0.25 vs 0.36; RUDDER contribution 0.04)
